title: Character combat and animation
robloxStudio: 0.746.0.7461269 observed on authoring workstation; recheck on replay
scenario: A player performs a telegraphed melee strike against a server-owned training target. A procedural local arm pose presents the windup and recovery; the server accepts damage only during the active window and only once per target per swing.
expectedOutcomes: Windup, active, recovery, and cooldown are distinct states.
Out-of-range, duplicate, and stale hits do not reduce target health.
Presentation animation does not grant damage authority.
failureCases: Target leaves range before the server resolves a hit.
Character respawn interrupts the local pose.

assets.source: Original native Roblox geometry and repository Luau; no external assets.

evidence.maturity: source-implemented; runtime and visual review pending
